1.consolidated_definition: dep. Deporte de raqueta que se practica en interiores con 2 ó 4 jugadores y una pelota de goma. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Por ello, las empresas tienden a construir instalaciones deportivas como, gimnasios, pistas de squash o paddle dentro de su mismo recinto para uso y disfrute de sus empleados (Universidad Interamericana, )
1.en_consolidated_definition: Paddleball is a racquet sport played indoors with 2 or 4 players and a rubber ball. This raw Anglicism is infrequently used; therefore, companies tend to build sports facilities such as gyms, squash courts, or paddle courts within their own premises for the use and enjoyment of their employees (Universidad Interamericana).
